cohort: Women with one previous cesarean section and an unfavorable cervix
finding: Cervical ripening with a double-balloon catheter was associated with a higher rate of vaginal birth compared to induction of labor with oxytocin alone, without an increased risk of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Double-balloon catheter for cervical ripening was associated with a higher rate of vaginal birth compared to oxytocin alone in women with one previous cesarean section.
